# MrJuaumBR

> Personal portfolio and project hub for João Pedro, known online as MrJuaumBR, a developer and creator from Brazil.

## Pages

- [Portfolio home](https://mrjuaumbr.github.io/): Single-page portfolio covering the developer profile, skills, projects, GitHub repositories, contacts, PC setup, favorite games and artists.
- [About](https://mrjuaumbr.github.io/#whoami): Developer background and interests.
- [Skills](https://mrjuaumbr.github.io/#whatiknow): Python, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Luau, Blender, Aseprite and 3D printing.
- [Projects](https://mrjuaumbr.github.io/#projects): Twelve project profiles shown as tabs on the homepage; the tabs are not separate page URLs.
- [GitHub repositories](https://mrjuaumbr.github.io/#github-projects): GitHub profile and repository listing.
- [Contacts](https://mrjuaumbr.github.io/#contacts): Public social and creator profiles.
- [PC setup](https://mrjuaumbr.github.io/#setup): Setup history for 2023, 2024 and 2026, plus current PC and console details.
- [LunaEngine project site](https://mrjuaumbr.github.io/LunaEngine): Separate project page for LunaEngine.

## Featured projects

- [Abyssal Eclipse 3DS](https://github.com/MrJuaumBR/AbyssalEclipse3DS): Fast-paced 2D pixel-art arena-survivor roguelite built natively for the Nintendo 3DS in C++17 with devkitARM, libctru, citro3d and citro2d. Five seasons, 137 spells, 25 enemy types, procedural asset generation, English and Portuguese (BR) localization.
- [LunaEngine](https://github.com/MrJuaumBR/LunaEngine) · [Project site](https://mrjuaumbr.github.io/LunaEngine): Python 2D game framework with systems for scenes, rendering, UI, effects, audio, storage and debugging; uses Pygame, NumPy, OpenGL and OpenAL.
- [NCheats](https://github.com/MrJuaumBR/NCheats): Browser-based cheat-code library for Nintendo Switch, Nintendo 3DS and Game Boy Advance.
- [LunaEngine-Games](https://github.com/MrJuaumBR/LunaEngine-Games): Companion game collection and desktop launcher for browsing, installing, updating and launching games.
- [DungeonGenerator](https://github.com/MrJuaumBR/DungeonGenerator): Configurable Python generator for seeded, multi-floor dungeon layouts, with BSP room placement, graph/BFS connections and JSON export.
- [RizzLeveling](https://github.com/MrJuaumBR/RizzLeveling): Interactive character dashboard with stats, skills, inventory, a live clock and canvas effects; it also inspired the portfolio’s Solo Leveling skin.
- [JPyDB](https://github.com/MrJuaumBR/JPyDB): Pure-Python storage system with a SQL-inspired table workflow and spreadsheet export.
- [Abyssal Eclipse](https://github.com/MrJuaumBR/AbyssalEclipse): In-development Python 2D roguelike shooter with randomized level-up cards.
- [Abyssal Eclipse 3DS](https://github.com/MrJuaumBR/AbyssalEclipse3DS): v0.1 2D pixel-art arena-survivor roguelite for the original Nintendo 3DS, written in C++17 with devkitARM, libctru, citro3d and citro2d. 147 spells, 25 enemy types, nine weapons, five seasons / 15 campaign levels, 23 achievements, procedural asset generation, English and Brazilian Portuguese.
- [Wireless Keyboard](https://github.com/MrJuaumBR/WirelessKeyboard): Python tool for connecting a phone browser to a PC server through a local URL or QR code.
- [Pixel Dungeon 2](https://github.com/MrJuaumBR/PixelDungeon2): Python/Pygame pixel-art RPG; the portfolio includes a screenshot showing version 1.0.3.
- [Medieval Life](https://www.roblox.com/games/14806242136/Medieval-Life): Roblox RPG project with a brief homepage overview and screenshot.
- [The Eclipse](https://www.roblox.com/pt/games/102068786196502/The-Eclipse): Roblox dark-fantasy RPG project with an overview and two embedded development logs on the portfolio.

## Profile and interests

João Pedro says he has been coding since age 10, starting with Small Basic and Scratch before moving to Luau, Python and JavaScript. The portfolio lists goals including studying Computer Science or Data Science, creating a 2D Python game and improving Python optimization skills.

The portfolio offers six selectable visual skins: the original default, Cyberpunk / Night City, Discord, Solo Leveling, Xbox 360 Dashboard and Windows XP. Each skin has its own color palettes. Seasonal effects are reserved for major holidays. The homepage also includes a setup-photo carousel, favorite-games collection and an endlessly scrolling favorite-artists carousel.

## Notes for crawlers and assistants

Project tabs and homepage sections are content on the single `/` page; their `#...` links are section anchors, not separate pages. Repository, Roblox and social links lead to external sites. The sitemap is at [sitemap.xml](https://mrjuaumbr.github.io/sitemap.xml).
